And it’s not just about stopping or trying to fix things—it’s about being allowed to feel without having to prove anything. Just sitting with that pain, without rushing to fix it or escape it, that can be a form of courage.

Because even if you don’t know what comes next, that moment of being with it—without judgment—might be the first step toward something new.
